params.body:
Pins the Gentells Standard to v0.14.0 (gentells-standard #19), in which Gaming is kept as the fourteenth element: the twelve classic elements, Codes and Gaming. Under 0.13.0 it was still `proposed`.

- `bin/sync-standard.mjs`: `STANDARD_REF` is `v0.14.0`; `packages/core/standard.mjs` and `standard-types.d.ts` regenerated by it (digest checked by the existing test).
- `packages/core/elements.mjs`: the comments say fourteen and no longer call Gaming proposed. Nothing in tagging changes: the pipeline already tagged Gaming, because a proposed term was taggable, and the discipline line that sends a signal about playing or streaming games to Gaming rather than Connectivity stays.
- `test/standard.test.mjs`: asserts Gaming is active.

Full suite: 1280 of 1286 pass; the 6 failures are report-render, which needs `pdftoppm` and is not installed on the workbench.
params.title: Read Gentells Standard 0.14.0: Gaming kept as the fourteenth element
